modelGuard.note: A route of these groups is vetoed where the request is a model change: a model element it never mentions with a build verb, a change verb or a UI widget; a build or change verb whose object is a model element (the verb not being a term of the route); a condition (quando/when/ao salvar/a cada) with any model element or click anywhere; a click on a UI widget; a concept that only exists inside an app (modelOnly). A trigger with a build or change verb holds only when that verb acts on one of its own nouns (objects). Readers (reader:true) never answer a build, change or save they do not name. Tools whose arguments are model elements (debugger, references, readers of a capture) are exempt. changeVerbs: with a model element among the words no tool explains, the hint says two parts; a verb after a modal (posso) is asked about.
